messages:
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy for release `api` -> chart:redwood/api-chart@v2.4.0 to cluster=prod-eu (canary=10%)
deploy-bot: command: `helm upgrade --install api redwood/api-chart --version 2.4.0 --namespace prod --set canary.enabled=true --wait --timeout 5m`
deploy-bot: ERROR during preflight: values schema validation failed
```
Error: values.schema.json: additionalProperties not allowed: "experimentalFeature"
  at validate (/charts/api/values.schema.json:45:12)
  at helm.release.preflight()
```
priya: holding traffic + pausing any further canaries. tagging this thread and pinging @oncall. :hand:
sam: saw 2xx rate drop ~2% and p95 spiked ~80ms on canary pods. stacktrace points to new sidecar resource in chart (experimentalFeature). think the schema change is what blocked helm validations.
kelly: where are the release notes for 2.4.0? need to know what the experimentalFeature is.
javier: quick look: chart adds `sidecar.inject` boolean and a new CRD flag. If values.schema rejects unknown keys, helm will fail. we can either rollback to previous chart (v2.3.7) or hotpatch by pinning chart version + setting image.tag to stable sha.
sam: i'd prefer pin to v2.3.7 then apply image patch — less blast radius than full rollback? also avoids toggling CRD changes in prod.
priya: agree. plan: 1) pin chart -> v2.3.7 2) set image.tag to sha-abc123 (last good) 3) run a 5% canary 4) monitor 15m then promote.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-054 — canary validation failure during helm upgrade (assigned: eng-oncall).
kelly: i'll draft a short release note blurb and add migration instructions about `sidecar.inject` for next chart bump. putting a note in the release PR to remove experimentalFeature if we want strict schema.
javier: command i'm about to run locally for canary patch (pasting so ops can mirror):
```
helm upgrade api redwood/api-chart --version 2.3.7 \ 
  --namespace prod \ 
  --set image.tag=sha-abc123 \ 
  --set canary.enabled=true,canary.weight=5 \ 
  --reuse-values --wait --timeout 5m --atomic
```
sam: LGTM. monitor metrics: api.request.p95, error.rate, and pod restarts. i'll watch Grafana dash and alerting.
deploy-bot: executing: `helm upgrade api redwood/api-chart --version 2.3.7 --namespace prod --set image.tag=sha-abc123 --set canary.enabled=true --set canary.weight=5 --wait --timeout 5m --atomic`
deploy-bot: canary deployment succeeded, pods ready=2/2, p95 within baseline.
priya: promoting to 50% then 100% after 10m if stable.
sam: observed no increase in latency or errors during 15m. promoting now.
javier: promoted to 100% via: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/api -n prod` (sync step)
oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-054 updated: resolved -> rollback avoided by chart pin + image patch.
kelly: follow-ups: open issue in charts repo to add migration note and optional `experimentalFeature` behind a feature flag, and add an integration test that validates values.schema.json allows unknown keys if flag present. i'll create PR.
priya: thanks everyone. scheduling a 2-hour change window next weekend to reattempt v2.4.0 with migration docs and CI checks. :calendar:
sam: also adding a preflight step to our rollout playbook: if helm validation fails with `additionalProperties` include automatic fallback to previous chart version to avoid full rollback.
kelly: noted. i'll include the playbook change in the runbook PR. :thumbsup:
